documents.title: Shareholder Meeting / Postal Ballot-Notice of Postal Ballot
Outcome Of Board Meeting Held On November 14, 2026.
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation

analysis.summary: In Q2 FY27, OnEMI Technology Solutions Limited (Kissht) reported registered users reaching 79.5 million and AUM reaching Rs. 9,317 crore, representing a 68.4% year-on-year growth. Profit after tax doubled year-on-year to Rs. 125 crore, supported by declining borrowing costs and credit costs. Management raised its full-year FY27 AUM growth guidance from 40% plus to 60% plus while targeting a reduction in impairment costs of more than 15% year-on-year.

guidance.claim: Management raised its FY27 AUM growth guidance from 40% plus to 60% plus.
guidance.quote: Given the momentum in the first half, we are raising our FY27 AUM growth guidance from 40% plus to 60% plus.

guidance.claim: Management expects impairment cost reduction to be more than 15% year-on-year.
guidance.quote: We are also raising our target for reduction in impairment cost, we had said it will come down by 10-15%. We are now saying it will be emphatically more than 15% reduction year on year.

guidance.claim: Management reaffirmed guidance for return on average equity above 20% and gross NPA below 2.25%.
guidance.quote: The rest of our guidance stands : return on average equity would be above 20%, and the gross NPA below 2.25%.

guidance.claim: The company holds to its guidance of achieving a 15% reduction in credit costs.
guidance.quote: We firmly hold to our guidance which we gave last quarter, which is 15% reduction in credit cost, and we are tracking well on that.

guidance.claim: Management remains on track for its FY27 guidance on AUM, Gross NPA, credit cost, ROE, and ROA.
guidance.quote: On the guidance for future, we remain firmly on track for the FY27 guidance we set out on different parameters, be it AUM, Gross NPA, credit cost, and profitability including ROE and ROA.

guidance.claim: Management expects the cost of borrowing to drop by 100 basis points in H2 FY27.
guidance.quote: So our guidance for FY, particularly H2 of FY27, that you will see the cost of borrowing dropping by 100 basis points and it will only increase as we, as the old debt basically runs off the book, right?

demand_outlook.claim: Consumption is turning up with FMCG value growth reaching 8.6% in Q2 despite softness in urban discretionary spends.
demand_outlook.quote: Despite a below-average monsoon and some softness in urban discretionary spends, consumption is turning up. FMCG value growth hit a six-quarter high of 8.6% in Q2.

demand_outlook.claim: Industry retail loan sanctions increased by nearly 20% year-on-year.
demand_outlook.quote: Across the industry, retail loan sanctions are up by nearly 20% year-on-year.

demand_outlook.claim: Registered users reached 79.5 million, up 32.6% year-on-year, while total served customers reached 12.8 million.
demand_outlook.quote: This quarter for us, registered users reached 79.5 million, up 32.6% year-on-year. We have now served 12.8 million customers, up 22.5%.

demand_outlook.claim: Disbursements for the quarter were INR 3,812 crores, up 37% year-on-year.
demand_outlook.quote: Disbursement for the quarter were INR 3,812 crores, up 37% year-on-year.

demand_outlook.claim: Registered users grew 33% year-on-year to 74.6 million.
demand_outlook.quote: The registered users grew 33% year-on-year to 74.6 million.

capex_expansion.claim: The company operates 107 LAP branches across 9 states and union territories.
capex_expansion.quote: We now operate across 107 branches in 9 states and union territories.

capex_expansion.claim: Management plans to deploy 25% of preferential issue proceeds towards corporate expenses including AI investments.
capex_expansion.quote: The remaining 25% will go as a combination of corporate expenses, particularly the investment in AI that we continue to keep doing.

capex_expansion.claim: The company's loan against property (LAP) business stands at an AUM of INR 617 crores across 101 branches in eight states.
capex_expansion.quote: LAP business which we started two years back, the AUM stands at INR 617 crores across 101 branches in eight states, about 7.7% of the total AUM.

capex_expansion.claim: The company has begun building capabilities in mutual fund distribution and secured an AMFI registration.
capex_expansion.quote: Separately, we have begun to build capabilities in mutual fund distribution.

capex_expansion.claim: The company's subsidiary has secured AMFI registration.
capex_expansion.quote: Our subsidiary has secured an AMFI registration already.

margins_costs.claim: Credit costs dropped to 6.2% of average AUM compared to 6.8% in the previous quarter and 9.3% in the prior year.
margins_costs.quote: Credit costs fell to 6.2% of average AUM, from 6.8% last quarter and 9.3% a year ago.

margins_costs.claim: Average cost of borrowing fell by approximately 70 basis points quarter-on-quarter to 13.76%.
margins_costs.quote: Even as borrowing costs rise across the system, our cost of borrowing has fallen by approximately 70 basis points, from 14.45% to 13.76%.

margins_costs.claim: Total finance cost as a share of average AUM declined by 100 basis points quarter-on-quarter.
margins_costs.quote: The total finance cost, as a share of average AUM, has also fallen by 100 basis points quarter on quarter.

margins_costs.claim: Pre-provisioning operating profit increased 40% year-on-year and 12% quarter-on-quarter to Rs. 287 crore.
margins_costs.quote: Pre-provisioning operating profit was Rs. 287 crores, up 40% year-on-year, and 12% quarter on quarter.

margins_costs.claim: The effective tax rate fell to 19% due to tax benefits associated with ESOP expenses.
margins_costs.quote: So the reduction in the tax rate, effective tax rate, is because there are some benefits linked to the ESOP expenses that the company has incurred.

margins_costs.claim: Total income reached INR 677 crores for the quarter, an increase of 45% year-on-year.
margins_costs.quote: Total income was INR 677 crores, up 45% year-on-year.

margins_costs.claim: Pre-provisioning operating profit grew 42% year-on-year to INR 256 crores.
margins_costs.quote: Pre-provisioning operating profit was INR 256 crores, which is up 42% year-on-year.

margins_costs.claim: Credit cost dropped to 6.80% of average AUM from 7.02% in Q4 FY26 and 8.85% in Q1 FY26.
margins_costs.quote: Credit cost was 6.80% of average AUM, down from 7.02% in Q4 FY26 and 8.85% in Q1 FY26.

margins_costs.claim: Return on average AUM stood at 5.05% and return on average equity was 21.20%.
margins_costs.quote: Return on average AUM was 5.05% and return on average equity at 21.20%.

margins_costs.claim: Operating expenses as a proportion of AUM declined from 19.9% to 18.0%.
margins_costs.quote: 19.9% cost which was opex as a proportion of AUM has already come down to 18.0% percent.

orders_capacity.claim: AUM grew to Rs. 9,317 crore, up 68.4% year-on-year and 16.4% quarter-on-quarter.
orders_capacity.quote: AUM reached Rs. 9,317 crore, up 68.4% year-on-year, and 16.4% quarter on quarter.

orders_capacity.claim: Quarterly disbursements grew 56% year-on-year to Rs. 4,612 crore.
orders_capacity.quote: Disbursements were Rs. 4,612 crore, up 56% year-on-year.

orders_capacity.claim: Active customers increased by 58% year-on-year to 3.61 million.
orders_capacity.quote: We have served 12.8 million customers, up 22% year-on-year, and active customers grew 58% year-on-year to 3.61 million.

orders_capacity.claim: LAP AUM reached Rs. 737 crore, representing 7.9% of total AUM.
orders_capacity.quote: AUM is Rs. 737 crore, or 7.9% of the total, up from 4.1% a year ago.

orders_capacity.claim: The company maintained a 45:55 split between on-book AUM of Rs. 4,199 crore and off-book AUM of Rs. 5,118 crore.
orders_capacity.quote: Funding remains well spread… on-book AUM of Rs 4,199 crore, and off-book AUM of Rs. 5,118 crore, a 45:55 split with more than 45 lending partners.

orders_capacity.claim: The company has served 12.25 million customers, an increase of 26% year-on-year.
orders_capacity.quote: We have now served 12.25 million customers, an increase of 26% year-on-year.

orders_capacity.claim: AUM split stood at INR 3,716 crores on-book and INR 4,284 crores off-book, supported by over 45 lending partners.
orders_capacity.quote: On-book AUM of INR 3,716 crores and off-book AUM of INR 4,284 crores, a 46:54 split, supported by more than 45 lending partners.

capital_allocation.claim: The company completed an Rs. 832 crore preferential allotment following shareholder approval on October 14.
capital_allocation.quote: We also completed a preferential allotment of Rs. 832 crore, approved by shareholders at the EGM on 14th October, and subsequently received in-principle approval from the exchanges.

capital_allocation.claim: 75% of preferential allotment proceeds will be infused into the subsidiary to support growth.
capital_allocation.quote: 75% will go as infusion into our subsidiary to fund our balance sheet and increase our support, our growth.

capital_allocation.claim: Net worth reached Rs. 2,377 crore with a capital adequacy ratio of 34.76% as of September 2026.
capital_allocation.quote: Talking about the balance sheet, net worth stood at Rs. 2,377 crore as on September 2026. Capital adequacy is 34.76%, down from 40.19% last quarter.
On book debt to equity is a conservative 0.94X.

capital_allocation.claim: Capital adequacy in the NBFC subsidiary increased to 40.2% from 25.3% in the previous quarter.
capital_allocation.quote: Capital adequacy in our NBFC subsidiary rose to 40.2% from 25.3% last quarter.

capital_allocation.claim: Net worth rose to INR 2,245 crores, supported by retained earnings, organic profitability, and the May 2026 IPO.
capital_allocation.quote: Net worth grew to INR 2,245 crores, nearly four times its level in March 2023, built on retained earnings, organic profitability, and the IPO completed in May 2026.

risks_headwinds.claim: Overlapping gold loan exposure was restricted to below 8% of the total book.
risks_headwinds.quote: Which has now come down to as low as sub 8% of the total book, with tighter curbs in the North than in the South.

risks_headwinds.claim: Exposure to drought-affected areas represents under 6% of the portfolio.
risks_headwinds.quote: Similarly, there's a risk on drought affected areas. There again, our contribution, or the business which comes from drought-affected areas, is around sub 6%.

risks_headwinds.claim: Customer overlap with MFI is under 3.4% and KCC overlap is under 2.6%.
risks_headwinds.quote: Of course, this data is not there in the KPI sheet, but my MFI overlap is less than 3.4%. My KCC overlap is less than 2.6%.

risks_headwinds.claim: Insurance revenue is under 1.4% of total income, mitigating potential earnings impact from IRDAI regulatory changes.
risks_headwinds.quote: Insurance is less than 1.4% of our total income, our offerings have always been voluntary, and we expect no material impact on earnings.

risks_headwinds.claim: West Asia developments pose risks via higher oil prices, elevated shipping costs, and customer confidence impacts.
risks_headwinds.quote: The first is West Asia, where the risk is not geography but transmission through higher oil prices, the cost of shipping, and, over time, the confidence of the customer.

risks_headwinds.claim: Industry bureau data shows building stress concentrated in small ticket loans and over-leveraged multi-lender borrowers.
risks_headwinds.quote: headline asset quality looks benign, yet beneath the surface, stress is building, concentrated in a few places, particularly in the small ticket loans or instances of borrowers carrying debt across several lenders at once, and households taking new lines only to service old ones.

management_commitments.claim: Management raised its FY27 AUM growth guidance to 60% plus.
management_commitments.quote: Given the momentum in the first half, we are raising our FY27 AUM growth guidance from 40% plus to 60% plus.

management_commitments.claim: Management targets an impairment cost reduction of more than 15% year-on-year.
management_commitments.quote: We are now saying it will be emphatically more than 15% reduction year on year.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects a reduction of at least 150 basis points in borrowing costs over the next 3 to 4 quarters.
management_commitments.quote: So, at the very least, there will be a 150 basis point reduction in the next 3 to 4 quarters.

management_commitments.claim: Management projects the LAP business to scale up by two and a half times over the next 2 years.
management_commitments.quote: If you apply that rate, we are almost talking about business becoming two and a half times.

management_commitments.claim: Management holds to its guidance of achieving a 15% reduction in credit cost.
management_commitments.quote: We firmly hold to our guidance which we gave last quarter, which is 15% reduction in credit cost, and we are tracking well on that.

management_commitments.claim: Management remains firmly on track for its FY27 guidance on AUM, Gross NPA, credit cost, ROE, and ROA.
management_commitments.quote: On the guidance for future, we remain firmly on track for the FY27 guidance we set out on different parameters, be it AUM, Gross NPA, credit cost, and profitability including ROE and ROA.

management_commitments.claim: Management projects a 100 basis points drop in borrowing costs in H2 FY27.
management_commitments.quote: So our guidance for FY, particularly H2 of FY27, that you will see the cost of borrowing dropping by 100 basis points and it will only increase as we, as the old debt basically runs off the book, right?

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
